title: class RouteError

blocks.md:
## Name the failure

`class RouteError extends Error {}` lets `catch (e)` ask `e instanceof RouteError`. A generic `Error` is a shrug. A named class is a signal.

blocks.promptMd: `throw new RouteError("blocked")` then `e instanceof Error` is…

choices.md: false — it is a different type

blocks.promptMd: > Define `RouteError`. `fail()` throws one with message `blocked`. Catch it and print `blocked`.

description: Make your own error type so the catch can tell stories apart.
